abstract: Make multi-node NVIDIA GPU clusters use their RDMA fabric with NCCL. Covers a bottom-up test ladder (ibstat, ib_write_bw, nccl-tests, engine), InfiniBand and RoCE checks, GPUDirect RDMA via nvidia-peermem or DMA-BUF, ACS and IOMMU pitfalls, the NCCL variables that matter, container and Kubernetes requirements for vLLM and similar engines, tuning, updates and troubleshooting, with a read-only node check script.
